candidates.name: Melanoma
support_spans: Incidentally resected lymph node showed focal involvement
H&E sections showed intense mixed superficial and deep dermal inflammatory infiltrate
MART-1 immunostain confirms complete tumor regression
candidates.why: The patient's history of a scalp lesion, lymph node involvement, and response to immunotherapy suggest melanoma.

candidates.name: Recurrent Melanoma
support_spans: Multiple satellite lesions were present on the left posterior auricular scalp area
After treatment, clinically regressed lesions with persistent black pigmentation were noted
candidates.why: The development of new satellite lesions despite treatment indicates recurrent disease.

candidates.name: Halogenoderma
support_spans: intense mixed superficial and deep dermal inflammatory infiltrate composed of numerous neutrophils, histiocytes, eosinophils, and lymphocytes
candidates.why: The histopathology findings of a mixed inflammatory infiltrate could be indicative of halogenoderma, a rare condition characterized by an inflammatory response to halogenated compounds.
candidates.protected_reason: Halogenoderma is a rare condition that may not be considered in the initial differential diagnosis, making it a potential candidate for minority protection.

candidates.protected_reason: This diagnosis may be challenging to establish due to its rarity and the need for careful histopathological examination.
